Commentary.Commentary: The Lankan bowling was really good throughout. Pushpakumara and Perera were the star as the two took a total of 7 wickets. Akila also was handy but one would wonder why he wasn't allowed to bowl more overs. Also, the fielding let them down and had it not been for the dropped catches, England would have not even crossed the 250-run mark. Now though, all that has to be put behind and the Lankan batsman have to get through the nervy period. Around 12 overs to go, will Sri Lanka end the day unscratched or will England get a wicket or two?

The top order for England once again failed to make an impact. Burns did play a good innings but could not make most of his start. However, Buttler's quickfire innings and Sam Curran's knock was the highlight. Especially the youngster, he came at the crease when England were in trouble at 165-6. However, two brilliant partnerships between Adil Rashid and Curran first and then Curran and James Anderson sees England go on top.

60 runs is what the last wicket has added. England were 225 for 9 after Rashid and Leach fell quickly post the break. Anderson then was dropped on 0. Post that, we witnessed the Curran show. He smashed the bowlers all around the park and he has taken England to a score which they will be more than happy with. He walks off to a standing ovation and he deserves every bit of it.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, bowled really well in the initial stages of the session but once again lost it towards the end. However, another decent start to the third session will see them wrap this England batting. We have had two shared sessions till now, who will the third one go to?

Sri Lanka did manage to get Foakes and Moeen Ali early in the second session. Buttler then continued and he brought up his half ton. However, he fell and at that time England were in trouble at 171 for 7. Sam Curran and Adil Rashid though have come to the rescue and the two are amidst a 41-run stand. The tourists will somehow hope they can get past the 250-run mark which will be a good score.

We are back for the afternoon session. Moeen Ali and Ben Stokes will resume their innings. Malinda Pushpakumara will start the proceedings. Here we go...
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...
Will Sri Lanka bowl the tourists out cheaply or will the English lower order once again come to their rescue? Join us in a while to find out.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, were excellent to begin with. They hit the right lines and lengths and the wicket also assisted them. Each of their bowlers, except for Dhananjaya has a wicket. However, they had England in a similar position in the first Test but failed to capitalize. This time though they would not want to repeat the mistakes from the last game.

Both the sides will be happy after the first session. England, because they have managed to score runs at a good rate. Sri Lanka, because they have got rid of the English top order. After electing to bat, the visitors lost Jennings early. Stokes then came out in his new batting position, looked fluent to start with but could not make most of the start. Root too, fell cheaply. Burns and Buttler did try and build a partnership of some sort but it was cut short as Burns fell 7 short of a half ton. Jos though has continued playing his strokes and England would hope he along with Moeen Ali can bat long.
Tosses it up around off, Ali tries to defend but gets an outside edge towards the backward point region. A single taken. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Surprisingly does not play the sweep shot this time as it is on the shorter side. He goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Buttler has either swept or has defended. Once again he brings out the paddle sweep through short fine leg for a brace.
Down the leg side and it is swept to fine leg for a run.
Fires it on middle, Ali works it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Moeen Ali defends it out.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl the last over before Lunch.
FOUR! Superb from Buttler again. It was bowled full on middle, Buttler goes down in one knee and creams it through deep square leg for a boundary.
Flatter on middle, Ali rocks back and tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Fires it on middle, Buttler sweeps it again towards sqaure leg . The batsmen rotate strike.
FOUR! Reverse sweep again from Buttler. Full toss on his pads, Buttler sweeps it crisply through deep square leg for a boundary.
Full on middle, Ali paddles it through fine leg for a run.
Fuller length on middle, Buttler reverse sweeps it through deep point for a single.
Reverse sweep towards deep point for a run. 13 from this over.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
From around the wicket bowls it down the leg side, Buttler tries playing the conventional sweep but misses.

FOUR! Make that three in three! Through the off side this time. They brought in an extra fielder on the leg side from the off side so Buttler decides to play the reverse, connects well through point and a boundary results. 100 up for England.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Once again Buttler plays the sweep shot and gets the desired result. It is creamed through square leg. Need not run for those.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! This is full and outside off, Buttler plants his front foot outside the line of off and then sweeps it crisply through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter trajectory on middle, Ali defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, Ali tries to sweep it but was hit on the pads. Bowler appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Buttler reverse sweeps it through the deep point region for a single.
Full on middle, Buttler leans forward and tries to defend it but gets the inside half of the bat and the ball rolls it to the leg side for a run.
Similar delivery, Buttler pushes it straight to the point region.
Fuller and quicker on middle, Buttler defends it from within the crease.
Floats it up on off, Ali blocks it out.

OUT! It is clean as a whistle! The bowling change has done the trick. Akila strikes in his first over.  A good catch by Dhananjaya de Silva. This is bowled slower through the air on off. The ball pitches and turns away. Burns plays inside the line, the ball takes the outside edge and goes low towards first slip. Dhananjaya seems to have taken it inches above the ground. Sri Lanka start celebrating and Burns starts walking back. The umpires though ask him to wait as they want to check if it has been taken cleanly. Replays roll in and it shows Dhananjaya has his fingers underneath the ball. Burns falls 7 short of his maiden Test half century! England slip further.
Have Sri Lanka got another? They have gone upstairs to check if the catch is clean.

A huge appeal but not given! This is flighted around off, it turns away. Bruns brings out the sweep. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat. Dickwella takes it and like he always does, puts in a loud appeal. The umpire is unmoved. The Lankans opt against the review and rightly so. Replays show that the noise was off the bat hitting the ground.
Nicely floated delivery around off, Burns tries to sweep it but the ball spins away and misses the outside edge of the bat. Good delivery that from the offie.
Drags his length short, Burns hangs back and cuts it through point for a run.
Starts of with a fuller delivery on middle, Rory defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Akila Dananjaya to roll his arm.
Eases this through mid on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
This is tossed up outside off, Burn goes for the reverse sweep but hits it onto the ground. Dhananjaya stops it.
Plays the sweep and it is in the gap through the square leg region. Another brace.
Slower through the air on middle, Burns works it fine down the leg side and takes two.
Once again plays the reverse sweep, it is not off the middle but the batsmen take a single as the ball goes through point.
Flatter in length on off, Burns hangs back and punches it off the back foot. The ball goes straight to the mid off region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller on off, Burns pushes it to the mid-off region.
Flighted delivery on middle, Buttler gets the leading edge and the ball rolls it to the off side. The batsmen rotate strike.
Tosses it up on middle, Rory pushes it the cover region for a single.
Little bit fuller on middle, Rory leans forward and tries to defend it but was hit on the pads. Luckily Rory gets the inside edge of the bat otherwise he would have been a goner.

Lovely shot! Now brings out the paddle sweep, hits it well for a brace. Bowl it on the stumps, he will paddle sweep you, bowl it outside off, he brings out the reverse sweep. Very tough to bowl at such batsman.
Once again brings the reverse sweep out but finds the fielder at point.
Good stop! Dilruwan saves a boundary! The reverse sweep comes out and it is hit well towards backward point. Perera there dives to his left and makes a good half-stop. Two taken.
BEAUTIFUL! Floats it up around off, it pitches and turns away. Buttler tries to play it with an open face but is beaten by the turn away.
Takes it on the full and paddle sweeps it fine for another couple. Buttler will keep finding ways to score.
Plays the paddle towards fine leg and a couple taken.
Fullish length on middle, Buttler works it to the fine leg region for a run.
Quicker on off, Buttler has pushed it to the mid on fielder.
Silva pushes it through on middle, Burns hangs back and punches it through point for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter trajectory on middle, Burns rocks back and punches it to the cover region.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on middle, Burns flicks it to the leg side.
Dhananjaya de Silva comes into the attack.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Floats it up on off, it is kept out.

NOT OUT! Buttler has made it in! That was vicious turn and bounce there for Pushpakumara. This was tossed up around off, it pitches, bounces a touch more and spins away quite a lot. Buttler tries to force it through the off side but is beaten. He drags his foot out and Dickwella collects the ball and whips the bails off. He appeals and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and it shows Buttler is safe.
A stumping appeal has been taken up. Good glove work from Dickwella but Buttler looks to be safe.
Uses his feet and drives it nicely but to the man at cover.
Floats it up on middle, Buttler gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Slower through the air on middle, Buttler defends it.
Short and wide outside off, Burns tries to slash it hard but misses it completely. Good take by the keeper.
Fuller on middle, Burns flicks it to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman tries to defend it off the back foot, the ball straightens a bit and hits the back pad. The bowler appeals but looked like it was missing the stumps.
FOUR! Dilruwan bowls it full on middle, Rory goes in one knee and sweeps it firmly through deep sqaure leg for a boundary. The fielder tries to stop it but it crosses the fence.
Flatter trajectory on middle, Burns taps it to the cover region.
Jos Buttler replaces his skipper.

OUT! TIMBER! Pushpakumara strikes! All three bowlers to have bowled now have one apiece. The straighter one does the trick. It is on off and it comes back in with the angle. Root tries to defend leaving a gap between bat and pad. The ball takes the inside edge, hits the pads and then the stumps. England's talisman falls cheaply and once again it is a left-arm spinner who gets him. Three out of three against that type of a bowler. England's top order once again fails to make an impact and they are in a spot of bother here.
Loopy ball on off, Root pords forward and blocks it out.
A little flatter on off, Root goes back and guides it to point.
FOUR! No one out in the deep so a boundary! Root goes down on one knee and sweeps it well, through square leg and it races away.
Gives it air on middle, the batsman blocks it out.
Sweeps it nicely with the turn through mid-wicket. A run taken.
On middle, Root defends it from within the crease.
Quicker on middle, Root defends it off the back foot and into the ground
On middle, the batsman defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller delivery on middle, Root works it off side.
Fullish length on middle, Burns works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up on off, Root has driven it to the point region for a single.
Tosses it up on middle, Burns pushes it straight to the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle, Root strokes it to long on. The batsmen rotate strike.
Fires it on off, Root pushes it to ther cover region.
Quicker on middle, Burns goes in one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Full on  middle, Rory defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Full toss on middle, Root drives it to long on for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, Burns goes back and guides it through point for a brace.
Eases this through mid on and takes a run.
A little too full this time, Root times it to mid on.
Tosses it up on off, Root defends it onto the ground.
Flatter again but it is a little too straight. Worked around the corner for a run.

That was close! Excellent effort! Actually, it would have been out had it hit the stumps. Burns dances down the track and flicks it towards short leg. Mendis there who is really sharp, sticks his hand out to the right. The ball sticks and then has a shy at the striker's end. Luckily for Burns it misses the stumps.
On middle, Root tucks it straight to the leg side.
Quicker on off, Rory pushes it to covers for a single.
Floats it up on middle, Root strikes it to wide mid on for a single. Brings up the fifty for England.
FOUR! Good intent from Root. Flighted delivery on middle, He comes down the track and goes uppishly over mid on for a boundary.
Full on middle, Root defends it of the front foot and into the ground.
Nicely tossed up by Puhspakumara on off, it spins away. Root tries to defend it off the front foot but misses the outside edge of the bat. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head.

EDGED BUT SHORT! En excellent over by Perera comes to an end! This is floated on off, it pitches and then turns away. Takes the outside edge of Burns bat but falls just short of the first slip fielder.
Fires it outside off, Burns throws his bat at it but gets it off the inner half towards covers.
Works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up around off, Root defends it onto the ground.
Drinks! Also, Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! Prodigious use of the review by Lanka! That looked really, really close and Hawk Eye returns three reds. Stokes there was beaten in length I feel. This is tossed up around off, Stokes goes back to a ball which he could have played forward. He tries to defend for the original trajectory but it straightens. Beats the outside edge of Stokes' bat and hits him on the back pad. A huge appeal follows but the umpire does not agree. Lakmal straightaway goes for the review. Replays roll in and it shows the on-field call has to be overturned. The Lankans are ecstatic. Ben Stokes' promotion did look like a good move when he started but it has not lasted long.
A huge appeal but not given! Stokes is once again the man in question and Lakmal has reviewed straight away. Looks very close this one.

Misfield! It is the skipper, Lakmal who is the culprit. Stokes uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still manages to drives it towards mid off and that too firmly. Lakmal slides and tries to stop but misfields. Concedes an extra run.
On middle, Rory flicks it straight to the the mid-wicket fielder. Starts off with a maiden.
Gives a bit of air on off, the batsman drives it straight to the bowler.
Identical delivery, Rory tucks it to the mid-wicket region.
Full on middle, Burns clips it to the leg side.
Tosses it up on middle, Burns pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery on middle, Rory defends it off the back foot and into the ground.
Malinda Pushpakumara is into the attack.
Two good balls to end! Flighted and on off, Stokes reaches out and keeps it out.
Tosses it up on off, Stokes defends it. Perera consistently needs to bowl this length and line.
Brings out the paddle and plays it nice and fine. A couple taken.
Better this one! A touch slower and it is on middle, goes on with the arm. Stokes tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. Burns wants a run but is sent back.
Short again and Burns punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide and it is asking to be put away! Burns does exactly that as he cuts it through point and the ball races away.
Full length delivery on middle, Rory clips it through fine for a single.
Back of a length around off, Stokes pushes it to the off side. The batsmen rotate strike.
Length delivery on middle, Stokes defends it by getting right behind the line of  the delivery.
FOUR! EXQUISITE! Overpitched from Lakmal, Stokes leans forward and drives it firmly through mid on and the ball races to the fence. Brilliant shot that.
Back of a length on middle, Burns taps it to the off side.
Back of a length on middle, Rory defends it with a straight bat.
On the off pole, the batsman lunges and keeps it out.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call but a good review in the end! It ended up to be much closer than we thought. This was bowled flatter and around middle, the ball straightens a touch. Stokes is on the back foot as he tries to block but plays for the original trajectory. It hits him high on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. After a chat, Suranga signals the 'T'. Replays roll in and it shows the ball to be clipping the top of the stumps. Lanka do not lose the review.
Review time! An appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Lakmal has signaled the 'T'. Looks high. Ben Stokes is the man in question.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle, Stokes leans forward and defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on middle, Stokes hangs back and pushes it towards point.
Lands it on a length and around off, Burns is half-forward and keeps it out.
Shuffles right across and the batsman works it to mid-wicket.
Way too wide outside off, tempting Burns to play a loose shot. He resists and makes a leave.

Good change in length there! The bumper and it is probably the first one. Stokes however, is in control of his pull shot and he plays it all along the ground towards deep square leg for a single. Not a bad move by Lakmal that with a fielder in the deep.
He has come out with an attacking approach here. Walks down the track and flicks it nicely but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Changes the angle and bowls it from over the wicket. He lands it on a length around off, Stokes defends it onto the ground.
On middle, the batsman drives it to the cover region.
Flatter trajectory from Dilruwan on off, Burns hangs back and defends it off the back foot.
Floats it up on middle, Rory defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length on middle, Burns taps it towards point.
FOUR!  His third of the innings. Full delivery from Dilruwan, Rory sweeps it fine towards deep square leg and the ball races away to the boundary.
Flatter delivery on middle, Stokes strokes it to long on for a single.
Back of a length on off, Stokes gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Around off, Stokes walks down the track and defends it towards mid off.
On the pads, the batsman works it through square leg for a single.
Three! Slightly short and outside off, Stokes nicely guides it through backward point for three. Runs will keep coming till the time Stokes is out there.
Another very confident and positive shot! This was slightly fuller in length around middle, Ben Stokes punches it towards mid on. The fielder fumbles but no runs conceded.
Good length around off, Stokes is confident in his defense.
Quicker delivery around off, Rory drives it sweetly to mid on.
Loopy delivery on middle, Burns leans forward and defends it off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Good shot that. Tosses it up on middle, Burns goes down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg and the ball races away to the boundary.
On middle, Burns taps it to the point region.
Little bit quicker on off, Rory pushes it through point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Easy pickings. Full and down leg, Stokes shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for a boundary to get off the mark.
Drags his length back on off, Stokes shoulders his arms to it.
Full and around off, Stokes blocks it out.
Ben Stokes is the new man in. This is the first time he will be batting at the no. 3 position. Can he do well?

OUT! Edged and taken! First blow for England and some good bowling from the skipper. Got one to go come in previously and this one straightens to get the edge. Runs in from around the wicket, pitches it full around off, the ball straightens. Keaton is forward to play at it. The ball takes a thick outside edge and Dickwella at the back makes no mistake. The centurion of the 2nd innings of the first game, falls early and this is just the start the hosts needed.
Better. Gets this one to come back in. On a good length, nips back in. Keaton points his bat skywards to let it through.
Comes from around the wicket and lands it full outside off, Keaton is not bothered to play at it.
On middle, the batsman plays it with a straight bat.
Flighted on middle, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Arm ball from Dilruwan,  Rory tries to flick on the leg side but misses it. It hits his front pad. The Lankans were thinking of taking the review but they did not go for it. Perera appeals but the umpire does not react to it. Replays shows that the ball was just clipping the stumps and the on field call would stay.
Tossed up on middle, Rory defends it off the front foot by presenting the full face of the bat.
Little bit flatter from Perera, Burns hangs back and defends it off the back foot.
Full on middle, the batsman tried to flick it but it hits the pad.
Back of a length outside off, Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery, came back a bit. Keaton pokes at it and misses completely.
Fuller length on middle, the batsman tucks it square leg. They rotate strike.
Full on middle, Burns defends it from within the crease.
In the channel outside off, Rory lets it be.
Length delivery angling in, Jennings works it to leg side for a single.
Turn from the first over itself. Loopy ball outside off, Burns looks to poke at it but is beaten again by the away turn.
A bit flat on off, Burns rocks back and gives it to the point fielder.
Outside off again, Burns cuts it towards point.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
On leg, Jennings looks to paddle it but it hits his pads and rolls towards fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Lovely. Loopy ball outside off. Keaton look to play it with a straight bat but gets beaten.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl from the other end.
Identical delivery, batsman shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery outside off,  the batsman lets it go.
Four! Easy pickings there for Burns. Full delivery on middle, he flicks it through mid on and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary of the innings.
Back of a length on middle, Rory defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Starts of with a full delivery on middle, Burns defends it off the front foot and into the ground.

We are all set to get underway! England openers, Rory Burns and Keaton Jennings make their way out to take center stage. For the home team, skipper Suranga Lakmal will take the new cherry. 3 slips and a gully for him.

TEAM NEWS - England named their team a day before the game with no changes. For the hosts, two forced changes. Roshen Silva and Malinda Pushpakumara come in for injured Dinesh Chandimal and retired Rangana Herath.
TOSS - Joe Root has won his seventh straight toss and opts to bat.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd Test between Sri Lanka and England live from Kandy. It is not often you hear the Lankans losing a Test match against a foreign team at home. They need to get their act together if they want to comeback in this Test series. With Dinesh Chandimal out with an injury and Rangana Herath retired, it is time for the experience of Angelo Mathews and co. to contribute and put up a fight. Coming to the visitors, they were brilliant both with the bat and ball. Keaton Jennings who was going through a lean pitch scored an outstanding 150-plus and the debutant Chris Foakes also scored a 100 on his debut. Bowlers were up to the mark as well with their three spinners taking the bulk of the wickets and winning the game for their side. We can expect the Lankans to fight back hard and compete in this match. It will be an interesting day of Test cricket. Do join us in a while.
